properties.entry: SELECT p.person_id, p.person_name, c.country_id, c.country_name, pe.period_id, pe.period_name, f.field_id, f.field_name FROM person p JOIN country c ON c.country_id = p.country_id JOIN period pe ON pe.period_id = p.period_id JOIN field f ON f.field_id = p.field_id ORDER BY p.person_id
